section_summary.extract_value: This Acknowledgement section states that the research received support from National Institute of Mental Health Grant MH-73937, awarded to Todd Kashdan, Ph.D. It also notes that portions of the manuscript were presented at the 2007 Annual Convention of the Association for Behavioral and Cognitive Therapies.
